title: Initiative choreography: quarterly delivery weave and commitment ledger
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Cross-functional initiatives lack a single, actionable choreography that ties company-level OKRs to per-team delivery lanes, explicit handoff contracts, and a live dependency register. Consequence: rework, missed milestones, and unclear escalation paths during quarter boundary transitions.

Proposal: Create an "initiative choreography" construct — a concise, repeatable artifact that includes (1) an objective-to-initiative mapping, (2) per-team delivery lanes for the quarter, (3) commitment ledger entries (what each team promises by milestone), and (4) a dependency register with owners, SLOs for handoffs, and escalation contacts. Pilot this choreography for three company-level OKRs in Q2 with two pilot squads (Serving Runtime + Console).
acceptance_criteria: Choreography template accepted by PM council and Eng leads
Pilot created for 3 OKRs with lane owners assigned
Dependency register populated with at least 12 discrete dependencies and owners
Weekly delivery lane board surfaced in the console (read-only link) and a working rollback/escalation playbook published
At least one canary rollout exercise executed and retro captured

risks: Capacity: Eng teams may not have bandwidth to meet committed milestones; mitigation: tiered commitments (must-have, should-have, stretch)
Tooling: Console integration work timeline (ENG-20780) could slip; mitigation: temporary Google Sheet/Drive + automation script
Cross-team misalignment: Vague ownership on infra-facing deps; mitigation: require explicit owner + backup on each register entry
Overhead: Too granular choreography artifacts may slow teams; mitigation: cap entries to critical-path dependencies only for pilot
metrics: OKR coverage: fraction of company OKRs with choreography artifact (target pilot: 3/3)
Dependency resolution lead time: median days from registration -> delivered (target <= 7 days for non-blocking)
Delivery predictability: percent of commitments delivered on milestone date (target >= 85% for pilot lanes)
Escalation throughput: time from escalation -> acknowledged by owner (target <= 24 hours)
Rollforward/rollback success rate in canary: binary pass/fail with annotated root cause
